title: threshold-driven observability add-ons + self-serve contract shortcuts
creator: Sofia Alvarez
description:
Goal: Test a threshold-triggered upsell flow that offers a compact observability add-on bundle and an expedited contract shortcut for enterprise customers once usage or error-rate thresholds are crossed. The experiment aims to increase attach rate for premium SLAs and compliance packs while reducing friction for legal intake via self-serve questionnaire shortcuts.

Background: Large customers often hit observability/retention needs unexpectedly (spike in traffic, incident post-mortem) and request faster SLAs + longer audit log retention. Current onboarding requires a full legal questionnaire and sales coordination which adds 2-4 weeks. We want to validate whether a lightweight, rules-driven offer tied to usage triggers will convert and speed up activation without exposing Redwood to undue contractual risk.

Hypothesis: If we surface a contextual banner/route-level offer when usage crosses a configurable threshold (e.g., sustained 95th pct token volume for 7 days OR audit log volume > X GB/month), 7% of eligible accounts will self-upgrade to a bundled add-on (observability retention + compliance checklist + 99.95% SLA) within 14 days. The self-serve contract shortcut (pre-populated questionnaire + limited legal T&Cs) will reduce time-to-activation from weeks to <72 hours for 60% of converts.

Experiment design:
- Trigger rules: define 3 signals (route token volume, error spike frequency, audit-log ingestion) and thresholds for eligibility.
- Offer variants (A/B/C): A) Price discount + 30d trial of extended retention; B) No discount, but accelerated contract shortcut; C) Bundled feature with usage-based rebate.
- UX: contextual banner in Console, email to account owner, and an API flag for partner integrations.
- Legal/Compliance flow: a 6-question condensed questionnaire maps to fallback escalation rules; automatic routing to Solutions Engineering for any escalations flagged by the questionnaire.
- Billing: one-click add-on purchase that creates a scoped invoice; backend flags tenant for dedicated retention and SLA profile.

Success metrics:
- Primary: attach rate among triggered accounts within 14 days >= 7%.
- Secondary: median time-to-activation <= 72 hours for self-serve contracts; net revenue uplift for the cohort >= 12% MRR uplift; reduction in legal review tickets for eligible converts by 40%.

Measurements & Signals:
- Events: banner_shown, email_sent, add_on_clicked, questionnaire_started, questionnaire_completed, contract_shortcut_used, billing_success, legal_escalation_opened.
- Dashboards: per-route conversion, time-to-activation histogram, legal-escalation rate, churn delta after upgrade.

Guardrails & risks:
- Risk: customers may misuse shortcut and accept terms that require deeper review. Mitigation: conservative default T&Cs, automatic 72-hr probation period for changed SLA terms, automated audit for red flags.
- Risk: pricing leak or negative perception. Mitigation: cohort-based rollout and non-publicized offers.
- Risk: infra cost increase for long retention. Mitigation: pre-check capacity + quota gating, and an automatic cap on retention per-tenant in the trial.

Rollout plan:
- Week 0-1: implement trigger detection and add banner UX prototype (Console + email template).
- Week 2: legal finalizes condensed questionnaire and mapping to escalation rules.
- Week 3: engineering enables billing flow and retention provisioning; QA run.
- Week 4: internal dogfood with 10 large tenants, monitor metrics and legal escalations.
- Week 5-6: gated external beta at 5% eligible traffic, run A/B variants for 6 weeks.

- Confluence PRD: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/PM/pages/OBS-Threshold-Upsell-PRD
- UX mockups: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-example-obs-ux
- Legal condensed questionnaire doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/obs-condensed-sq-v1
- Measurement spreadsheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/obs-upsell-metrics

Open questions:
1) Exact threshold numeric bounds (SRE to propose baseline based on recent 90-day telemetry).
2) Pricing tiers for bundle alternatives - finance needs sign-off on target margin.
3) Which stakeholder (AE vs. Solutions Eng) owns escalations for each variant?
4) Whether trial converts revert to prior retention settings automatically at trial end or auto-bill.

Next steps: finalize thresholds with infra/SRE, lock down condensed questionnaire with Legal, and create the measurement dashboard in Looker before beta.
